pages.title: Life Star
pages.text: §lAcquisition: §r Crafted at a crafting table with 9 different flowers. Any 9 different flowers work (items are compared by ID, so different tulip colors count as different flowers).$(br2)§lEffect: §r$(br)Active while held or embedded in armor: max health increases from 20 to 50; regeneration speed is doubled; hunger and saturation drain 50% slower (including the saturation consumed by fast regeneration).
Note: just place 9 different flowers (compared by item) — colors do not need to match. The grid above is only an example.
